reason: This plugin is primarily a memory and knowledge context layer for DeepSeek Harness: it exposes update/retrieve/subscribe services for agent workflows, supports pluggable local or remote memory/knowledge plugins, and includes durable storage through a Rust backend (including SQLite and artifact ingestion). The repository’s own description and feature list consistently position it as an agent memory context hub rather than a UI, media, or standalone analytics tool.

summaries.zh: Patchouli 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供面向智能体的本地优先记忆与知识上下文服务，支持 update/retrieve/subscribe，并可接入本地或远程记忆/知识后端。
summaries.en: Patchouli is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides a memory and knowledge context service for agents with update/retrieve/subscribe workflows, supporting pluggable local or remote memory/knowledge backends.

capabilities: Exposes DeepSeek Harness services for updating, retrieving, and subscribing to memory/knowledge data
Routes and aggregates memory/knowledge provider results with user or plugin filtering
Ingests artifacts such as images and workspace files into typed storage
Runs a Rust-backed storage component with SQLite support and remote provider options
